Traders should monitor daily INMET updates and model refreshes for potential shifts from convective activity, as urban heat islands can amplify peaks by 1–2°C.

Recent updates on May 12 reflect stable mild conditions following 26°C highs earlier in the week, but inherent short-term uncertainty in cloud evolution and frontal influences keeps traders hedging across 24-27°C outcomes. Daily JMA revisions expected tomorrow could sharpen consensus.

Climatologically, May averages 28–29°C highs, underscoring the unsettled setup's downward pressure.
